summary: Motor accident compensation appeal; functional disability reassessed at 90% due to amputation impacting earning capacity; age corrected to 22 years based on documentary evidence; multiplier adjusted to 18; monthly income upheld at Rs.6,000; future prospects awarded at 40%; total compensation enhanced to Rs.28,93,494 from Rs.6.7 lakh (MACT) and Rs.10.1 lakh (HC); impugned judgment modified.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.279, s.337, s.338, s.427
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation revised and enhanced to Rs.28,93,494; impugned award modified accordingly; interest as awarded by Tribunal to apply.
